discipline: dungeon-micromoth — the local stochastic surrogate: micromoth-sampled policy vs argmax on the vendored quilt-dungeons core. Sealed BEFORE the eval ran; the fleet-seeds preregister@1 ritual (seal pushed in the pre-eval commit is the timestamp the fleet can prove).

experiment.note: The 73-c JEV-tuned waveform is not in this repo; the experiment runs the authored baseline weight SHAPE so the tested mechanism is sampling-vs-argmax over identical weights, not the weights themselves.

claims.claim: Temperature 1.0 sampled policy (micromoth-sampler, seeded measurement collapse) scores >= the argmax policy on >= 5 of the 8 eval seeds (exploration pays).
claims.refusal: Fewer than 5 of 8 seeds with meanScore(T=1.0) >= argmaxScore => FAIL: sampling at T=1.0 does not pay on this policy/dungeon family.

claims.claim: Temperature 2.0 sampled policy scores < the argmax policy on >= 5 of the 8 eval seeds (over-exploration hurts) — which together with P1 makes the temperature curve single-peaked: it rises from argmax into T~1.0 and falls by T=2.0.
claims.refusal: Fewer than 5 of 8 seeds with meanScore(T=2.0) < argmaxScore => FAIL: over-exploration does not hurt, no single-peaked-curve evidence at these temperatures.

vacuousIf.note: If sampled episodes show zero score variance pooled across all temperatures and seeds, the temperature knob did not discriminate this run — VACUOUS, never PASS.
